scientific_integrity: Analytic reduction and first-step recurrence give the all-size proof; finite independent linear-system calculations provide supplementary diagnostics. Published renewal principles and continuum threshold are acknowledged. Scientific priority has not been independently established.
scientific_limitations: Exact for two independent simple nearest-neighbor walkers on odd cycles with joint geometric resetting; excludes even-cycle equal-parity sectors, heterogeneous hops, independently triggered resets and a classification of global reset optimizers. This is a mathematical theorem for a specified model, not an experiment.
title: Fourier law for first-collision locations under synchronous resetting on odd cycles
